text.en: Behind you, no, not behind. He's in the ruin by the old stones. Rook. Don't let him talk. He talks until you're close.
text.id: Di belakangmu, bukan, bukan di belakang. Dia di reruntuhan dekat batu-batu tua. Rook. Jangan biarkan dia bicara. Dia bicara sampai kau dekat.

text.en: Cut these ropes after. If there is an after.
text.id: Potong tali ini nanti. Kalau masih ada nanti.
